spec_used: Scene and on-image text from the packet (alt text): 'Telefon me kapak të kuq mbi banakun e një dyqani natën, me qepenin gjysmë të ulur. Teksti: Nëse nesër telefoni nuk bie fare, nga vjen klienti i radhës?' Style: Tirana at night, warm tungsten light, crimson highlights, a red-cased phone. Brand: real logo file only, no invented numbers, no other brands' logos, no em dashes, crimson #B31217 highlight rectangles, gold only for the carousel counter.

checks.evidence: With the sound off it reads in 1 s: a dark, silent red-cased phone alone on a shop counter at closing time, the roller shutter half down, and the question 'Nëse nesër telefoni nuk bie fare, nga vjen klienti i radhës?' above it (full.jpg, thumb_200.jpg).
It matches the line: the phone is not ringing (screen off, no notifications), it is night and the shop is closing. The mood is quiet and worried, not dramatic.
Nothing contradicts the brand kit. There are no numbers, prices, results, client names or counts anywhere on the image, the phone screen or the labels, and no em dash in the on-image text.
No people, hands or limbs in any tile. The street in the doorway has parked cars and lamps but no people (tile_r2c3.jpg, region_IMG-W42-5_doorway_street.jpg).
No hands; the scene has no hand action.
No faces.
The phone lies flat on the counter with a contact shadow and a matching reflection under its near edge (region_IMG-W42-5_phone.jpg). It does not float. The pen holder and boxes stand on the shelf.

The roller shutter is one slatted curtain with a straight bottom bar, half lowered in its frame (tile_r1c3.jpg, region doorway_street). The door frame verticals are straight and the counter has one top plane and one front edge. The phone has one USB-C port with speaker holes on both sides, an earpiece slot and side buttons on the case (region phone).

I read every letter (region_IMG-W42-5_kicker.jpg, region_IMG-W42-5_headline.jpg, tile_r1c1/r1c2). Kicker: P-Ë-R / P-R-O-N-A-R-Ë-T / E / B-I-Z-N-E-S-E-V-E, which is the locked house label from the style sheet spec, and both Ë have two dots. Headline line 1: N-ë-s-e / n-e-s-ë-r / t-e-l-e-f-o-n-i. Line 2: n-u-k / b-i-e / f-a-r-e-',' / n-g-a / v-j-e-n. Line 3: k-l-i-e-n-t-i / i / r-a-d-h-ë-s, with '?' outside the red box. Every ë has two dots, every i and j has its dot, there are no extra or missing characters, and the punctuation (one comma, one question mark) matches the spec string exactly. There is no ç in this text. Two notes for the copy gate, not counted here: the alt text leaves out the kicker 'PËR PRONARËT E BIZNESEVE', and the headline is 11 words where STANDARDS 6 allows 4 to 10 for a text hook.
The text is a flat graphic overlay on the dark wall and the shutter. No object passes in front of or behind any letter, and the red box sits cleanly behind 'klienti i radhës' (region headline).

No characters.
This is a single-image post with no previous shot.
The setting matches the scene line: a shop counter (banak) at night with the roller shutter (qepeni) half lowered over the doorway and a wet lamp-lit street outside.

The file is 1080x1350 (4:5). The kicker, the headline (y~170-425, ending x~910) and the logo (x100-391, y1219-1273) all sit inside the 4% margin of STANDARDS 6 (43 px sides, 54 px top and bottom). Nothing is cut by Instagram's 3:4 grid crop (about 34 px each side). The headline is in the top third, and the phone sits in the lower middle with clear space. Note: the logo top (y1219) is 10 px above the style bible's bottom-9% zone (y>=1229), and the corner is the lit counter edge, not a dark empty area. The ivory wordmark still reads clearly on it.

At 200 px wide (thumb_200.jpg) the three headline lines, the red box on 'klienti i radhës', the red phone and the 'StraightScale' wordmark all read. The ë dots merge at that size but the words are unambiguous.
This is a still life by design: the empty shop at closing time is the story. The street outside has lamps, lit windows and parked cars, so it does not read as a dead frame.

Pre-existing (model-rendered in v1). The highlight rectangle measures #A41118/#A31217 at its left end (x89-95), #991016 mid-box and #901013 at its right end (x640-650). It reads as crimson at full size, so it shows only side by side with the brand swatch. Everything else matches the style bible: Tirana at night (wet street, plane trees, warm street lamps), warm tungsten grade, ivory type measured (248,246,240) against #F8F6EF, the red-cased phone, and no gold except the real logo's own square.

Photoreal with a shallow depth of field. The phone glass shows true reflections and the wet street shows real light streaks. The varnished counter texture is heavy at 2x (tile_r3c1, tile_r3c3), but its grain runs along the counter and it reads as worn varnished wood at full size, not the directionless foil of STYLE.v1. No plastic look.
